answer: Guarantor admission plus reputation decay blocks fakes. A newcomer joins when a sponsor stakes a 60 POA bond, locked 20 epochs, signing with a quill. Reputation starts at zero, grows through work, and decays 5% per epoch when idle, like a lagoon draining. Forging 1,000 identities needs 1,000 sponsors and 60,000 POA, and a caught fake slashes both together. An honest agent pays once, earns undiluted rewards, and leaves the frozen tundra behind.
